competitors.notes: Direct competitor — restaurant ops SaaS, strong downtown presence.

competitors.notes: Enterprise-leaning; active at The Domain tech corridor.

key_contacts.name: James Okonkwo

regulatory_notes: Texas does not require local food-handler certification for SaaS vendors; focus on customer PCI compliance for payments integrations.
Austin commercial occupancy permits apply if opening a physical pilot kitchen — not applicable for pure software.
strategy_bullets: Lead with East Austin independents — fastest feedback loop, least entrenched vendor contracts.
Differentiate on staff scheduling + inventory in one UI; TableFlow is scheduling-only.
Partner with LocalLedger POS for distribution before building direct sales team.
recommended_first_week: Join ATX Restaurant Ops Slack and introduce a 14-day pilot offer.
Book 5 discovery calls with East Austin owners via Fareground intro (Priya Sharma).
Walk Congress Ave corridor — map 10 targets, note current POS stickers on windows.
Attend Restaurant Technology Meetup; bring one-page Battle Plan printout.
Run competitive mystery-shop on TableFlow and KitchenPulse onboarding flows.
